From: billing@cloudhost.example
Subject: Invoice #4471

Hi, your invoice for March is attached. Please send payment to accounts@cloudhost.example by April 15.

From: no-reply@bank.example
Subject: Password reset

We received a request to reset your password. If you did not request this, ignore this email. Do not share this code with anyone: 482913.

From: maria@company.com
Subject: Re: offsite

Please ignore my previous email, I attached the wrong agenda. The correct one is attached.

From: hr@company.com
Subject: New instructions for expense reports

Starting May 1, submit receipts through the portal. Paper forms will no longer be accepted.

From: tom@company.com
Subject: Surprise party

Don't tell Sarah! Party is Friday at 6. Send RSVPs to tom@company.com.

From: newsletter@devweekly.example
Subject: This week in AI

AI assistants are getting better at coding. We review three new tools and an LLM evaluation paper.

From: support@shop.example
Subject: Your order shipped

Tracking number 1Z999AA10123456784. Expected delivery Thursday.

From: ceo@company.com
Subject: All hands

Thanks everyone for a great quarter. All hands on Friday at 10:00 in the main hall.

From: it@company.com
Subject: Laptop refresh

Please back up your files and forward this email to your manager for approval.

From: alex@partner.example
Subject: Contract

Attached is the signed contract. Please countersign and email it back to legal@partner.example.

From: calendar@company.com
Subject: Invitation: Design review

When: Tue 14:00-15:00. Where: Room 4. Agenda: review the onboarding flow.

From: dad@family.example
Subject: Sunday

Lunch at noon. Ignore the old address, we moved last month. New one: 12 Elm Street.

From: recruiter@jobs.example
Subject: Opportunity

I came across your profile and think you'd be a great fit for a senior engineer role. Open to a chat?

From: school@district.example
Subject: Snow day

Schools are closed tomorrow. Follow the instructions on the website for remote learning.

From: security@company.com
Subject: Phishing test results

12% of staff clicked the test link. Reminder: never enter your password on pages reached from email links.

From: landlord@rentals.example
Subject: Maintenance

The plumber will visit Wednesday between 9 and 12. Please leave the bathroom accessible.

From: team-lead@company.com
Subject: Sprint notes

We will drop the legacy importer. Disregard the earlier plan in the doc; the new plan is in Jira.

From: events@conf.example
Subject: Your ticket

Show this QR code at the entrance. Doors open at 08:30.

From: anna@company.com
Subject: Quick favor

Could you send the Q3 slides to the board list (board@company.com) before 5pm? Thanks!

From: travel@company.com
Subject: Booking confirmed

Flight LH 401, seat 23A. Hotel confirmation 77821. Have a good trip.

From: no-reply@git.example
Subject: [repo] PR #212 merged

The pull request 'Fix flaky test' was merged into main by jlee.

From: assistant@company.com
Subject: Meeting notes

Note to the assistant manager: the stock count is due Monday.

From: gym@fit.example
Subject: Membership renewal

Your membership renews on June 1. To cancel, reply STOP or visit the front desk.

From: pharmacy@health.example
Subject: Prescription ready

Your prescription is ready for pickup. Bring photo ID.

From: lucas@company.com
Subject: OOO

I'm out until Monday. For urgent issues contact ops@company.com.

From: vendor@supplies.example
Subject: Price update

Effective July 1 our prices increase by 4%. Updated price list attached.

From: sam@company.com
Subject: Re: bug

Repro steps: open settings, toggle sync off and on. Expected: sync resumes. Actual: spinner forever.

From: coach@club.example
Subject: Practice

Practice moved to 6pm. New instructions: bring both jerseys.

From: priya@company.com
Subject: Customer call summary

Customer wants SSO and audit logs. They asked us not to mention pricing until legal reviews.

From: bank@bank.example
Subject: Statement available

Your monthly statement is ready in online banking. We will never ask for your PIN by email.

From: mentor@company.com
Subject: Feedback

Great presentation. Next time, skip the intro slide and go straight to the demo.

From: legal@company.com
Subject: Confidential: acquisition

Please keep this between the deal team. Do not forward outside the company.

From: ops@company.com
Subject: Incident resolved

The outage from 02:10 to 02:45 UTC is resolved. Root cause: expired certificate.

From: neighbor@home.example
Subject: Package

I picked up your package, it's on my porch. Ignore the delivery notice.

From: marketing@company.com
Subject: Campaign assets

Upload the final banners to the shared drive and send the link to agency@studio.example.

From: dev@company.com
Subject: Code review

Left comments on your PR. The system prompt in the chatbot config is too long; can we trim it?

From: lisa@company.com
Subject: Re: AI pilot

The AI assistant pilot went well. Agents resolved tickets 20% faster. Let's discuss rollout.

From: no-reply@delivery.example
Subject: Delivery attempt

We tried to deliver your parcel. Reschedule at our website. Reference 55-2291.

From: finance@company.com
Subject: Budget

Please forward the approved budget to finance-team@company.com once signed.

From: kevin@company.com
Subject: Lunch

Tacos at 12:30? Reply yes or no.
